policy_presence.summary: Retained public Claims show scoped institutional material. Currentness and complete policy coverage remain PARTIAL.

ai_disclosure.summary: Study-work records require an independence/AI-use declaration with tools and purposes. Prompt logs are not made a universal duty here; doctoral disclosure has separate requirements.

coursework.summary: The retained guideline generally allows AI and language models within examiner/instructor rules while preserving independent work. It does not offer unrestricted permission.

exams.summary: The same conditional framework requires checking examiner and course rules. The record does not establish that AI is allowed in every exam or discipline-specific assessment.

privacy_data_entry.summary: The guideline advises against entering sensitive, personal, confidential or copyrighted text into AI systems that may process it outside university infrastructure. Preserve this advisory strength and context.

academic_integrity.summary: Independent work and study-work disclosure remain central conditions. Neither these records nor held faculty examples establish a university-wide sanction or appeal deadline.

approved_tools.summary: The computing-centre record describes university-hosted YoKI and model choice for members. It does not establish universal account eligibility, costs or permission for assessed use.

named_ai_services.summary: Named services in retained Claims are discovery context only; eligibility and assessment permission remain unverified.

teaching_guidance.summary: Instructors are asked to design AI use around learning goals and tell students which applications are permitted or prohibited. Task and examiner conditions still apply.

research_guidance.summary: Doctoral guidance requires stating when, where, why and to what extent AI was used. AI remains an aid to independent intellectual work; this doctoral rule is not expanded to all publication types.

security_procurement.summary: No retained Claim establishes a separate university-wide AI procurement process in this view. Data-entry advice and YoKI hosting should not be recast as such a process.
